wiz.welcome.title: Welcome
wiz.welcome.subtitle: {0} setup
wiz.welcome.body:
This wizard installs {0} on this computer.
The default is a per-user installation
(%LOCALAPPDATA%, no administrator rights). A system-wide
installation for all users (UAC prompt) or a custom
installation folder is optional.

Your projects and settings are never deleted.
wiz.license.title: License Agreement
wiz.license.subtitle: Please read the license terms
wiz.scope.title: Install Location
wiz.scope.subtitle: For whom and where to install?
wiz.scope.hintall: Installing for all users requires administrator rights: the standard Windows UAC prompt appears when setup starts. If you decline, nothing is installed.
wiz.scope.hintuser: A per-user installation needs no administrator rights and installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs.
wiz.scope.migrate: Migrate existing installation (removed first; projects and settings are preserved)
wiz.scope.found: Existing installation {0} found in {1} — it will be updated. Projects and settings are preserved.
wiz.scope.conflict: An installation {0} exists in {1} [{2}]. The selected scope/folder differs — without confirmation nothing is installed (no parallel or silent migration).
wiz.scope.errconflict: An installation in a different scope/folder exists. Confirm the migration or choose the matching scope and folder for an upgrade.
wiz.options.title: Options
wiz.options.subtitle: Shortcuts and file associations
wiz.options.note: File association note: Windows 10/11 decides the actual default app in system settings. This wizard only registers the open command for {0} and never silently overwrites existing associations — on uninstall only entries pointing at this installation are removed. Your projects and settings under %APPDATA% are always preserved.
wiz.summary.title: Summary
wiz.summary.subtitle: Review the installation before it starts
wiz.summary.note: The installation writes only into the chosen folder and the matching registry scope. Projects and settings under %APPDATA% are never touched.
